name: Prince
source:
The Dark Tiger's No.2.
He and Lau Ming Wa have been close friends since childhood. 
With his support, the Dark Tiger attempted to expand into Hong Kong, but failed.
He later learned that Lau Ming Wa had been murdered by the Red Flower Society and wanted to take revenge on Yvet.
When Yvet comes to Macau with Luk, they have a meeting, but Prince is convinced that Yvet has Yvet's own reasons.
He then uses Yvet as he sees fit.

The Dark Tiger's No.2.
